title: The True King
wikitext: {{ Quest infobox | id = 50 | name = The True King | given by = [[Duke Barradin]] | given at = [[The Barradin Estate]] | region = Ascalon (pre-Searing) | campaign = Prophecies | type = Secondary | nationality = Tyrian | preceded by = [[Trouble in the Woods]] | experience reward = 750 | completion reward = 100g ({{reforgedmode}} only), [[Divine Symbol]], [[War Hammer]] of Fortitude | map = [[File:The True King Map.jpg|250px]] | map1text = The trek from [[the Barradin Estate]] to [[Fort Ranik]]. }} Travel to [[Fort Ranik (pre-Searing)|Fort Ranik]] to deliver a [[message from Barradin]] warning [[Lord Darrin]] about the [[Vatlaaw Doomtooth|Charr Ranger]] sighting. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = pre | test = n | complete = [[Trouble in the Woods]] }} ===Objectives=== * Travel east from the [[Barradin Estate]] to [[Lakeside County]]. Head south to [[Ashford]]. Take the southeast bridge to [[Regent Valley (pre-Searing)|Regent Valley]]. Once in Regent Valley, follow the road to Fort Ranik. * Deliver the message from Barradin to Lord Darrin. ===Reward=== * 750 [[Experience]] * 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only) * [[Divine Symbol (loop)|Divine Symbol]] (Loop skin) ** [[Energy]] +3 ** Halves casting time of spells (Chance: 5%) ** [[Armor rating|Armor]] +5 (while [[Hexed]]) *[[War Hammer (ball)|War Hammer]] [[of Fortitude]] (Ball skin) ** [[Blunt Dmg]]: 8-10 ** Damage +15% (while Health is above 50%) ** [[Health]] +15[[#salvageable|*]] * Can be [[salvage]]d == Walkthrough == If you have already unlocked Fort Ranik, simply map travel there to complete the delivery. Otherwise, make your way to Regent Valley via Lakeside County or [[Wizard's Folly]]. Refer to the quest map for guidance. Once there, follow the road signs to Fort Ranik and hand the letter to Lord Darrin to claim your reward. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Duke Barradin :''"I recently received word from [[Devona]] that a Charr Ranger has been sighted south of the wall. [[Little Thom|Thom]] and I will begin scouring the countryside for this creature.'' :''"In the meantime, I need someone to go into Regent Valley to '''Fort Ranik''' and '''deliver a message warning Lord Darrin'''. He must begin his own search for this [[Charr]] fiend."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I am honored to be entrusted with this duty. | decline = I am not a messenger. | ask = The road to '''Fort Ranik''' is not easy, especially with Royalists thick as they are in the woods, but road signs should get you there. Follow the roads from Lakeside County into Regent Valley. You'll find Fort Ranik at the far end of the valley. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Lord Darrin :''"What's this? A letter from the duke? Oh, I see. The good duke suggests that I am not doing enough to serve [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|Ascalon]]. See what he says here? "I trust you and your men, being so far from the conflicts at the Wall, have ample resources to hunt down this Charr."'' :''"Between you and me, Barradin is fortunate he is so skilled a [[Warrior]]. Else he'd learn to regret being such a poor diplomat. In any case, his message has been received. You may consider yourself dismissed."'' {{Pre-Searing Quest nav}}
